services.name: CrossFit Classes
services.desc: Welcome to Kid's CrossFit Classes at CrossFit Vic City! This program is specifically designed to introduce children to the fundamentals of CrossFit in a fun and engaging way. For all levels, our classes focus on developing strength, coordination, and teamwork skills. Participants will enjoy a mix of functional movements, play-based activities, and age-appropriate workouts, all while fostering a love for fitness from a young age. The result? Stronger, healthier, and more confident kids ready to take on any challenge! Join us for Kid's CrossFit Classes and set your child up for a lifetime of fitness success. Experience the best of Kid's CrossFit Classes at CrossFit Vic City in Victoria, BC.
